children: Catcher Predict monitoring showed sharp volatility in the Polymarket submarket for the Winston-Salem Open match between James Duckworth and Arthur Fery, where the "Duckworth" option in the second-set winner market rose from 27% one hour earlier to 54.45%. According to ChainCatcher, the move reflected a 27.45% swing and may have been influenced by breaking news.

title: Polymarket Duckworth Option Jumps to 54.45% in Winston-Salem Open Match Market
